historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures tag text without locator, string-index integrity or asset-system semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds trusted inventory/privacy controls but assumes uniqueness and SPD relevance that must remain policy-dependent.

original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 17 Asset Tag string reference and value follows the approved memory-component asset-management policy for its locator and remains stable after reboot; allow blank, shared or placeholder values only where that policy explicitly permits them.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17/string-table data in controlled evidence, bind Asset Tag index/value to locator/serial/part identity, validate the string reference and approved normalization, compare the authoritative asset database when tags are assigned, apply policy-specific blank/duplicate rules and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves whether module-level asset tags are assigned, their authoritative inventory and reboot plan. No tag programming or physical label reading is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Whether Type 17 asset tags are required per populated locator
Expected tag values or approved blank/placeholder convention
Authoritative asset inventory and locator/module mapping
Normalization, privacy, duplicate and evidence-retention policy
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/asset inventory; never write Asset Tag or change firmware/hardware.
Validate the raw string index and preserve raw value under approved access controls.
Do not assume tags must be unique; evaluate uniqueness only if the asset policy requires it.
Do not use SPD as an asset-tag authority unless the project documents a specific mapped field; module serial is not the same as Asset Tag.
Stop on invalid reference, ambiguous authoritative mapping or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate string reference/value, policy-specific blank/duplicate handling, authoritative inventory match and protected pre/post reboot stability.
Do not program tags, infer them from serials, alter modules or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve asset-tag usage, baseline, duplicate/placeholder/privacy rules and authoritative system.
Approve reboot/recovery, interpret policy exceptions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The displayed tag is relevant, but grep -A1 loses locator/serial/part identity, raw string index and cannot establish whether a blank or duplicate is policy-valid.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete raw Type 17/string data into controlled evidence; report locator/module identity, index validity, protected raw/normalized tag and policy-specific asset-inventory/duplicate result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Asset Tag scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing, tag writes and hardware changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate each Type 17 Asset Tag string reference, compare assigned tags to the authoritative asset system, apply explicit blank/placeholder/duplicate rules and use protected evidence for reboot stability.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 records on projects that either manage module asset tags or explicitly permit unassigned values.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and asset-inventory version/export identity.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Asset Tag string-index semantics and the project's authoritative asset-management policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string integrity, explicit asset-management semantics, authoritative mapping and privacy-aware evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects invalid string references, wrong-module tags and unauthorized blanks/placeholders without inventing a universal uniqueness rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Asset Tag may legitimately be unprogrammed and is distinct from manufacturer serial; SPD usually does not supply this administrative field.

project_override_considerations: A project can approve no module-level asset tagging or common placeholders; that choice must be explicit and scoped. If real tags are assigned, replacement/repopulation plans must update the locator-to-asset baseline rather than silently accepting drift.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module map, asset-tag assignment/baseline and blank/duplicate/privacy policy
Controlled complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/string data
Per-locator index validity and protected raw/normalized tag
Authoritative asset-inventory comparison or explicit approved unassigned-state result
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot protected tag comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Asset Tag is a clear string field; whether it is assigned or unique is project policy, not an inherent source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String and policy comparison are fully automatable after the project supplies its asset rules.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string integrity, locator/module context and project asset semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains privacy/inventory safeguards, corrects uniqueness and SPD authority to policy-dependent, and restores FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates asset-tag administration from serial identity and final engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Avoids falsely failing legitimate unassigned/common tags while still detecting malformed references and mismatches where the project actually manages module assets.
independent_technical_reasoning: String reference and policy/baseline comparisons are deterministic; the existence and uniqueness requirements are explicit inputs rather than manual acceptance steps.
